expectation: Membrane ring on activated/exhausted T cells, mostly CD4 Tfh and CD8, a minority of immune cells. Clustered in lymphoid aggregates and T-cell-rich stroma and scattered at tumour margins; absent from tumour epithelium and acellular stroma.
observed: A: focal clusters of bright cells in several images (row 1 #3, row 2 #3, row 3 #4), but haze over whole tissue in two images (row 2 #4, row 3 #2). B/C: mostly fine grain, a few small bright cell clumps. D: hazy, not cell-resolved. E: PD1 patches sit inside CD4-rich areas, with some white overlap.
why: PD1+ cell clusters sit inside CD4-rich lymphoid regions as expected, but background grain and haze over whole tissue in some images keep the contrast low.
notes: PD1 forms focal clumps of cells in aggregate-like regions, and in row E they fall on CD4-rich areas, so the stain is specific. Diffuse haze in two images and grain across the typical fields make it low contrast.
